The United States Space Force (USSF) at Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado is searching for a Program Manager for the MILSATCOM Product Support Delta (NH-1101-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: Leads a cross-functional team of Government and contractor personnel providing sustainment/product support for United States Space Force Military Satellite Communication programs. Manages daily program execution in an effort to ensure fielded systems meet Space Operator/user's mission requirements.

Serves as the primary interface between the Government Program Office and Prime MILSATCOM Contractors. Manages existing contracts and plans/develops requirements for future contracts. Evaluates proposals to ensure proposed level(s) of effort and costs are in-line with Government requirements.

Oversees programs' Weapons Systems Sustainment (WSS) requirements and advocates for current and future funding needs.

Ideal Candidate: Prrogram management experience, familiarity with the defense acquisition management framework, prior experience developing and managing program/system requirements, working knowledge of the various acquisition disciplines (e.g.

Financial Management, Contracting, Logistics), Bachelor's Degree (mandatory), APDP (or equivalent) Program Management certification (highly desired) Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Knowledge of methods of supervision to hold others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results. Ability to plan, organize, and direct the functions of a unit and mentor, motivate, and appraise subordinate staff.

Determine objectives, make sound, well-informed, and objective decisions, set priorities, cause change, and accomplish organizational goals. 5.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 6.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 7.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

Ability to compose and edit contract required correspondence, review and analyze directives, develop and brief service contract program related presentations.

Hi, I'm Jace , and I founded Ashby's Customer Education function in 2025. We've expanded the team since then, I now lead the team and am excited to be hiring our next Program Manager!
Our team is built on a simple belief: Ashby Academy should feel like every customer's personal CSM. Regardless of tier or team size, every Ashby customer deserves content that meets them where they are — practical, accurate, and genuinely useful.

That standard shapes everything we build, and it's what's driven the development of our growing Academy courses, webinar program, and playbook library. We have ambitions to expand both the depth of our content and the formats we deliver it in, and this hire is a meaningful part of getting there.
As our next Customer Education Program Manager, you'll own customer-facing education work end to end. We're looking for someone who knows Ashby well enough to coach users on how to use it, and can translate that coaching into content that scales. You'll turn complex product workflows into clear, practical learning experiences, and partner closely with Customer Success, Product, PMM, and Recruiting Operations Consulting to make sure what we build is grounded in how customers actually work.
This is a hands-on role. You won't be setting strategy and handing it off. You'll be in the work: scoping, writing, building, reviewing, refining, and shipping.

Own net-new customer education work from concept through publication, including courses, playbooks, recordings, and other learning assets
Define the goal and shape of each learning asset — what it should help customers do, for whom, and in what format — then gather SME input, design the approach, and build it
Refresh and improve existing Academy content so it stays aligned with how Ashby actually works today
Translate complex Ashby workflows into clear, practical, outcome-oriented education — the kind that helps customers understand not just what to do, but why it matters
Partner cross-functionally with CS, Product, PMM, and RecOps Consultants to identify high-value education opportunities and get the right assets out at the right time
Contribute to the systems, standards, and workflows that help Customer Education scale while maintaining high-quality learning experiences
Help us explore adjacent formats when useful — lighter-weight tutorials, in-app guidance, and other just-in-time learning moments
Typical workload: You'll manage 2-3 new courses or major playbooks per quarter, plus ongoing refreshes and maintenance of existing content. Most of your time goes into building the work yourself (writing, recording, designing learning flows).
Examples of work you might own
Build a new Academy course that helps customers adopt a new Ashby feature or module
Turn product and SME input into a practical playbook tied to a real recruiting outcome
Record voiceover for a customer-facing learning asset
Audit and refresh an existing course after a product change so it reflects how Ashby works today
Partner with RecOps Consulting or other SMEs to build something that helps customers apply a concept, not just understand it
Experiment with lighter-weight format when a full course isn't the right answer

You already know Ashby well. You understand how its workflows are structured, where users can get stuck, and what it takes to use it effectively. Formal customer education experience isn't required. What matters is Ashby fluency and the ability to translate that into coaching and content.
Beyond your Ashby depth, you could be a great fit if you also have:
You've taught something complex before. Whether live, through writing, or both, you've helped someone understand a complicated product or process and have ideas on how to turn that into something scalable.
You can juggle multiple projects. You manage several at once without losing momentum when priorities shift.
You're a strong writer. You can make complicated things feel clear and useful on the page.
You're comfortable recording voiceovers. Recording yourself for customer-facing content feels natural, not like a stretch.
You own work end-to-end. You can take something from problem framing through build and launch without needing a fully mapped plan first.
You work well with subject matter experts. You know how to pull what you need from busy stakeholders without losing momentum or clarity.
You have good judgment about scope. You can tell when something should be deep, lightweight, or optimized for speed, and you choose intentionally.
Traditional customer education experience isn't required. The background that matters most is hands-on Ashby experience — as a recruiter, a recruiting ops practitioner, an implementation specialist, a CSM, or someone who has simply used Ashby deeply enough to teach it. If you've owned meaningful work with real autonomy, improved how something gets taught or documented, and cared about outcomes over optics, you'll likely feel at home here.
This role may not be a fit if
You're still building Ashby fluency. This role leans on already knowing Ashby well, since you'll be teaching it from day one. If you haven't had the chance to build that hands-on depth yet, this particular role isn't the right fit.
You prefer to set strategy and hand it off. This is a hands-on role. You'll be the one scoping, writing, recording, and shipping, not directing someone else to do it.
You need a fully defined scope before you can do your best work. You'll often be the one deciding what shape an asset takes and how deep to take it, without a fully mapped plan.
You'd rather optimize an established system than help shape one. You'll have the chance to define how this program works and put your stamp on the approach, building something you're proud of rather than fine-tuning what's already set.
You want a coordination or project-management role. This is a maker seat. Most of your time goes into building the work yourself, not managing a queue of other people's.
You measure success by how much content ships. We care about whether the right education gets built and whether customers actually use it: engagement, progress, adoption of the workflows it supports, and reduced dependence on 1:1 support are all signs that the work is landing.
You're energized by large, highly structured teams. You'll often be responsible for identifying where structure is needed and putting it in place yourself
About Ashby
We’re building the next generation of enterprise software and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We are well-funded, have incredible product market fit, and are backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom
We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 4,000 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we're hiring for this role

Support employees and leaders through changing processes, systems, SOPs, and performance expectations

Use learning technologies, including appropriate AI-enabled tools, to create engaging and effective learning solutions

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.
Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met.

Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.
As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.
What you'll own
Onboarding projects
Build and own the project plan for each new laboratory, from kickoff to go-live, with dependencies and dates kept current.
Direct the work across our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and the customer's staff.
Accompany the validations customers run as part of onboarding. The laboratory's medical director designs the study; you make sure the technical setup is correctly installed and working, that our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and that the customer has everything they need to complete it.
Carry the committed go-live date, and raise risks early with options rather than after a slip.
Customer success after go-live
Act as the customer's main point of contact once live, monitoring usage and engagement and reaching out proactively.
Own incoming support requests: resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop with the customer.
Bring what you learn from customers into product planning, and flag potential expansion opportunities to Sales where relevant.Bring what you learn from customers into product planning.
You do not carry a sales target. But flagging expansion opportunities to Sales is part of your responsibility.
How you'll start
You will take on real customer onboarding projects from the start and lead them yourself, with close support from the team and from your manager in the beginning. As you build familiarity with our products and our customers, you move into running them independently.
Your Profile
A degree in biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, medicine, or a related field.
3+ years leading projects with external customers — clinical or diagnostic implementation, digital pathology, medical device or laboratory rollout, health IT deployment, or comparable delivery work.
Proven ability to build a realistic project plan and drive it to a date, updating it responsibly and transparently as things change.
Proven ability to direct people inside and outside the company.
Technically confident: able to discuss interfaces, integrations and data credibly with ML engineers and IT staff, instruct them clearly, and translate between them and the customer.
Able to hold a room with a laboratory director, a pathologist and an IT lead, and keep all three aligned.
Full professional proficiency in English. German is not required.
Based in Hamburg, or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.
Willing to travel to customer sites internationally — occasional trips, typically a few times a year, focus on US customers.
Comfortable with the occasional late-afternoon or early-evening call to overlap with customers in other time zones.

Experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments, or a background in the natural sciences.
If you have not worked in pathology: evidence that you have become competent in an unfamiliar technical domain before.
Experience working within a quality management system, or delivering software into a regulated clinical setting.
Commercial instinct.

Die BWT Schweiz, bestehend aus den Unternehmen BWT AQUA AG und BWT AQUA Pharma \& Biotech AG, hat ihren Hauptsitz in Aesch BL und beschäftigt rund 500 Mitarbeitende. Beide Unternehmen sind Teil der BWT\-Gruppe. BWT ist Europas führendes Wasseraufbereitungsunternehmen mit mehr als 80 Tochter\- und Beteiligungsgesellschaften sowie über 6500 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.
BWT hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Wassertechnologien zu entwickeln, zu produzieren und zu vermarkten, die den Menschen eine bessere Lebensqualität bieten. Der Industrie werden ökonomisch sowie ökologisch sinnvolle Lösungen in der Wasseraufbereitung zur Verfügung gestellt.
Unser Portfolio an Technologien und Produkten deckt vom Wassereingang bis zum Verbraucher alle Bereiche der Wasseraufbereitung ab. In unseren Hauptbereichen Wasseraufbereitung für Industrie, Gewerbe und Private, Reinstwasser und Trinkwasserspender sorgen wir für perfektes Wasser im täglichen Leben. Abgerundet wird unser Angebot durch einen umfassenden Service.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Projektabwicklung in der BWT AQUA Pharma \& Biotech AG suchen wir dich als
Projektleiter Pharma\-Anlagenbau 100% (alle)
Deine Aufgaben
Du leitest Projekte im Bereich Pharmawasser, Clean Utilities und GMP\-Anlagenbau technisch und kommerziell – von der Projektinitiierung bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe an den Kunden.
Du koordinierst interne Fachteams wie Engineering, Automation, AVOR, Produktion, Montage und Qualifizierung sowie externe Partner und Lieferanten.Während der gesamten Realisierungsphase bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden in technischen, terminlichen und kommerziellen Fragen.
Du stellst sicher, dass Projektziele in Bezug auf Budget, Termine, Qualität, GMP\-Compliance und Dokumentation erreicht werden.
Du steuerst Projekt\-Reviews sowie Risiko\- und Änderungsmanagement und verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent bis zum Projektabschluss.
Du begleitest FAT, SAT, Inbetriebnahmen und Übergaben und unterstützt bei Qualifizierungsaktivitäten.
Du bist bereit, innerhalb der Schweiz zu reisen und bei Bedarf projektbezogen auch international im Einsatz zu sein.
Dein Profil
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Ingenieurstudium, zum Beispiel in Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik oder Automation, oder bringst eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit.
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektleitung im Anlagenbau, idealerweise im Pharma\-, Biotech\-, GMP\- oder Clean\-Utilities\-Umfeld.
Du bringst ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Wasseraufbereitung, Rohrleitungsbau, Automation und pharmazeutische Dokumentationsanforderungen mit.
Erfahrungen in GMP\-konformer Projektabwicklung, Qualifizierung, FAT/SAT, technischer Dokumentation sowie strukturiertem Abweichungsmanagement ist von Vorteil.
Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch; ösischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
Du trittst sicher auf, denkst kundenorientiert und überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations\-, Organisations\- und Moderationsfähigkeiten.
Du arbeitest selbständig, präzise, lösungsorientiert und belastbar – und hast Freude daran, komplexe Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Wir bieten dir
Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung in einem wachsenden Marktumfeld.
Die Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen Pharmawasser\-Projekten mit hoher technischer Relevanz und klarer GMP\-Ausrichtung.
Ein lösungsorientiertes, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem internationalen BWT\-Netzwerk.
Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, moderne Arbeitsmittel und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der BWT\-Gruppe.
Das ist BWT
Flache Hierarchien und ein familiäres, wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld. Gelebte Du\-Kultur bis in die oberste Führungsebene. Langjährige, engagierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die unsere Werte mittragen. Ein erfahrenes, eingespieltes Team, das dich bei deiner neuen Aufgabe unterstützt.

business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order-
to-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS, Leo and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the LATAM region.
This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement.

As a Program Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make smart trade-offs between competing priorities.

You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle — not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of
how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post-launch operational data into actionable improvements — you will set the standard for AI-augmented program delivery.

You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one-way and two-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results,
understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.

The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large-scale, complex business program implementations in fast-paced, deadline-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.

· Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle — from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post-launch analysis. We want someone who doesn't just knows about AI but who delivers programs differently because of it.

· The ability to work backwards from the problem — challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.

· High-judgment decision-making — distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.

· A metrics-driven approach that designs measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction) — while knowing when to trust judgment over data.

· The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to Directors.

· A track record of optimising cross team processes, applying improvement methodologies and building mechanisms that lift team efficacy and delivery.

· Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross-functional decision making without authority.

For our **Artwork Design** team, we are looking for an experienced professional to join us as
**Artwork Management & Change Control Manager (100%) (m/f/d)**
In this role, you will support the efficient and compliant execution of **Artwork Management and related Change Control processes** across our network. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external artwork design partners, you will help ensure reliable end-to-end processes, adherence to agreed service levels and alignment with global best practices.
As a key and administrative user of the **Global Artwork Management System (GLAMS)**, you will provide operational system expertise and support effective ways of working across the stakeholder network. As part of an evolving organization, you will also contribute to defining, implementing and continuously improving Artwork Management and Change Control processes.
You will report directly to the **Head of Artwork Management and Change Control**.

* Drive the efficient and reliable execution of Artwork Management processes, ensuring effective end-to-end interfaces and collaboration across internal stakeholders and external artwork design partners.
* Act as a key and administrative user of the Global Artwork Management System (GLAMS), supporting effective system use and related processes across the relevant stakeholder network.
* Support the definition, implementation and continuous improvement of Artwork Management and Change Control processes, contributing to lean, efficient and scalable ways of working.
* Collaborate closely with external artwork design partners and internal stakeholders to support timely and compliant execution and adherence to agreed service levels.
* Support and influence stakeholders involved in artwork creation and maintenance to ensure adherence to established processes and global best practices.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of a lean Change Control process, working across functions to enable efficient execution.
* Support artwork development for new product launches and coordinate relevant activities with internal and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to process-efficiency and continuous-improvement initiatives across Artwork Design and related Change Control activities.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Design, Packaging, Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in Artwork Management, Artwork Coordination, Design, Labelling, Supply Chain or a related function.
* Experience with process definition, implementation and/or continuous improvement is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of Artwork Management processes and systems; experience with GLAMS or a comparable Artwork Management System is highly desirable.
* Experience working with external design partners, agencies, vendors or other service providers is an advantage.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical or another regulated industry is advantageous but not required.
* Green Belt, Lean, Operational Excellence or equivalent certification is an advantage.
* Fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.
* Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and priorities.
* Strong communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external partners.
* High degree of flexibility, curiosity and self-learning capability, with the ability to quickly build expertise in new systems and processes.
* Comfortable working in an evolving environment, where processes and responsibilities continue to develop.
**About this position**
* You will join an evolving team and work at the interface of **Artwork Management, Change Control, systems and process improvement**. The position offers a high degree of cross-functional interaction and requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders as well as external artwork design partners.
* As the organization and its processes continue to develop, you will have the opportunity to contribute your experience to the definition and improvement of ways of working rather than simply executing established processes. Your ability to learn independently, adapt to changing requirements and build effective relationships across the organization will therefore be important to your success.
Interested in this opportunity? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV, employment references and degree certificates.

Notre client est une PME industrielle suisse spécialisée dans la fabrication de composants de haute précision pour des secteurs exigeants tels que l'aéronautique, le médical, l'horlogerie et l'automobile. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'évolution de ses processus, l'entreprise souhaite renforcer son équipe de direction avec un Responsable Qualité capable de faire évoluer durablement son système qualité.
## Job Description ##
**Vos responsabilités en tant que :**
* Piloter et faire évoluer le système de management de la qualité.
* Garantir la conformité aux normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Structurer les processus qualité et renforcer leur intégration dans les opérations.
* Développer une culture d'amélioration continue auprès des équipes.
* Piloter les audits internes, clients et de certification.
* Suivre les indicateurs qualité, les non-conformités et les actions correctives.
* Collaborer étroitement avec la Production, les Méthodes et la R&D.

* Accompagner l'évolution du système qualité dans le cadre de la migration vers un nouvel ERP.
* Participer aux projets liés aux futures certifications, notamment ISO 14001.
* Manager et développer une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Participer aux décisions stratégiques en tant que membre du comité de direction.
## The Successful Applicant ##
Le profil idéal du Manager Qualité
* 8 ans d'expérience minimum en qualité dans un environnement industriel.
* Expérience confirmée dans la mise en place, la structuration ou l'amélioration d'un système qualité.
* Très bonne maîtrise des normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Une expérience dans l'aéronautique est fortement privilégiée ; une expérience dans le médical est également très appréciée.
* Bonne compréhension des environnements de production et des problématiques techniques industrielles.
* Anglais B2 minimum.
**Ce qui fera la différence**
Nous recherchons une personne pragmatique, autonome et capable de challenger l'existant.
Vous savez appliquer les normes avec rigueur tout en gardant une approche proche du terrain et des réalités industrielles. Votre capacité à fédérer les équipes et à faire évoluer les pratiques sera essentielle.
## What's on Offer ##
* Un rôle stratégique au comité de direction.
* Le management d'une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Un environnement industriel de haute précision.
* Une forte exposition aux secteurs aéronautique et médical.
* Un réel périmètre d'action pour faire évoluer le système qualité.
* Une entreprise familiale en croissance, avec une vision à long terme.

Position Title: Commissioning Project Manager
Position Location: Remote – United States. Must be located near a major airport.
Travel Requirements: Up to 50% domestic travel. Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.

The Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems.
The Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.
The role may assist with developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws, and specifications.
This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the DLB commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.
The Commissioning Project Manager will receive limited directions on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.
This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)
Assist with pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
Coordinate and support resource and material forecasting
Develop, manage and monitor schedule
Participate in, schedule or lead project meetings
Coordinate / perform QA / QC and Cx plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs.

Onboard project team for mobilization
Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
Lead and assist in preparation of final commissioning report for submission to client
Monitor and Control Project Financials (15%)
Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project
Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
Manage Stakeholder Relations (15%)
Assist in the preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
Assist in the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
Support contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
Ensure client satisfaction through active communication
Perform On-site Commissioning Activities (10%)
On-site inspection, validation, functional testing, verification and troubleshooting of electrical and mechanical equipment
Participate in factory witness testing and observe startup activities
Use technical equipment to perform testing
Direct vendors / contractors in the execution of the testing
Develop Testing Plans and Procedures for Complex Projects (5%)
Development of commissioning plans
Prepare pre-functional checklists
Prepare functional performance test scripts
Review Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (5%)
Review shop drawings and submittals

Du hast bereits in einer Agentur gearbeitet , behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick und fühlst dich zwischen Kundenmeeting, Contentproduktion und Projektplanung wohl?
Dann suchen wir dich als Projektmanager (m/w/d) für unser Team bei wirdenkenlokal .
Wir sind Medienhaus und Agentur mit Sitz in Nürnberg und unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbar zu werden , neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen . Dafür entwickeln und realisieren wir Projekte rund um Social Media, Video- und Fotoproduktion, Onlinekampagnen, PR und Events .
Für die Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt , strukturiert arbeitet und gleichzeitig versteht, dass Agenturalltag nicht immer nach Lehrbuch läuft.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Steuerung unserer Agenturprojekte – von der Planung über die Koordination der Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei betreust du Social-Media-Projekte, Videoproduktionen, Fotoshootings und weitere Online-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, führst regelmäßige Kundentermine und berätst sie entlang unseres Leistungsportfolios. Du verstehst, was der Kunde erreichen möchte, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende Lösungen.
Koordination & Überblick: Mehrere Kunden, unterschiedliche Deadlines und verschiedene interne Ansprechpartner gleichzeitig? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du priorisierst Aufgaben, koordinierst Timings und Ressourcen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was wann zu tun ist.
Contentproduktionen: Du bist nicht nur am Schreibtisch: Bei ausgewählten Video- und Fotoproduktionen unterstützt du unser Team vor Ort, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Kreativen sicher, dass die Anforderungen des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Social-Media-Managern, Videografen, Fotografen und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Informationen, Feedback und Freigaben laufen bei dir zusammen und werden von dir strukturiert weitergegeben.
Projektmanagement mit Awork: Wir organisieren unsere Projekte mit Awork. Du musst das Tool noch nicht kennen – Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Awork, Asana, Monday, Trello oder vergleichbaren Lösungen setzen wir allerdings voraus.
KI & Prozessoptimierung: Wir nutzen KI bereits intensiv in unserem Arbeitsalltag und wollen das weiter ausbauen. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sowohl innerhalb von Kundenprojekten als auch zur Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse einzusetzen, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Qualifikation
Agenturerfahrung: Du hast bereits in einer Marketing-, Social-Media-, Digital-, Content- oder vergleichbaren Agentur gearbeitet und kennst die Dynamik des Agenturalltags.
Erfahrung im Online-Marketing: Du bringst praktische Vorerfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für Social Media, Contentproduktion und Onlinekampagnen mit. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können – aber du solltest verstehen, wie gute Projekte in diesen Bereichen geplant und realisiert werden.
Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig steuern, Prioritäten setzen und verlierst auch dann nicht den Überblick, wenn an einem Tag fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.
Stressresistenz: Wenn es turbulent wird, wirst du nicht hektisch, sondern fokussiert. Du kannst mit Zeitdruck, kurzfristigen Änderungen und intensiveren Projektphasen umgehen und läufst dann eher zur Höchstform auf, als den Überblick zu verlieren.
Kommunikationsstärke: Eine klare, professionelle und zielführende Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – setzen wir voraus. Du kannst sowohl souverän mit Kunden kommunizieren als auch intern klare Briefings und Aufgaben formulieren.
Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, sprichst Probleme frühzeitig an und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Interesse an Marketing & Medien: Social Media, Marketing, Medien und digitale Kommunikation interessieren dich auch über deine unmittelbaren Aufgaben hinaus. Du willst verstehen, welche Plattformen, Formate und Entwicklungen gerade relevant sind.
Offenheit für KI: ChatGPT, Claude und andere KI-Tools sind für dich keine Bedrohung, sondern Werkzeuge. Du hast Lust darauf, herauszufinden, wie wir damit bessere Ergebnisse erzielen und effizienter arbeiten können.

Abwechslung statt immer gleicher Projekte: Vom regionalen Mittelständler bis zum Konzern, von Social-Media-Betreuung über Recruitingkampagnen bis zur Videoproduktion: Du arbeitest mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und an sehr unterschiedlichen Projekten.
Du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: Unsere Projekte sollen nicht einfach nur gut aussehen. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbarer zu werden, neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen – insbesondere Unternehmen aus unserer Region.

## Job Description ##
In this role, you will support the day-to-day management and improvement of HR policies, processes and practices.
You will review existing HR policies, procedures and guidelines and coordinate the necessary updates with HR colleagues and other internal stakeholders. This will involve working directly on documents, templates, forms and supporting materials to ensure they remain accurate, clear and easy to use.
You will help translate legal, regulatory and internal requirements into practical HR procedures.
You will follow relevant changes, identify which documents or processes need to be adapted and coordinate updates with the appropriate specialists.
A key part of the position will be process improvement.
You will review how existing HR processes work in practice, gather feedback from users, identify recurring issues and propose practical adjustments.
You will also use available data and KPIs to monitor processes and identify areas where efficiency or service quality can be improved.
You will work closely with different HR teams to support the implementation and consistent application of policies and procedures.
This may include answering questions, clarifying processes, preparing guidance and helping colleagues and managers understand how policies should be applied in practice.
You will coordinate a range of HR projects and improvement initiatives.
Your responsibilities will include preparing project plans, organising meetings and workshops, following up on actions, coordinating contributors, tracking deadlines and deliverables and ensuring that agreed changes are implemented.
You will organise and facilitate working sessions with relevant stakeholders to gather requirements, review existing practices and agree on practical solutions.
You will also support the rollout of new or updated HR policies and processes.
This includes coordinating validation, preparing implementation materials and working with communication colleagues to ensure that information is clear, accessible and available to the relevant audiences.
The position requires regular coordination with multiple stakeholders and the ability to manage several topics simultaneously while ensuring accurate follow-up and documentation.
## The Successful Applicant ##
We are looking for an experienced HR professional who enjoys working on concrete HR processes, policies and projects and who is comfortable moving between detailed documentation and stakeholder coordination.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.
